cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 and early sodium chloride make this an effective cleanser, but CAPB plus a very early cationic polymer/panthenol/oil/silicone care phase keeps the net architecture below a strong reset shampoo.

formulaFacts.observation: early electrolyte/thickening context, not counted as a separate cleanser

cleansingStrength.counterSignal: No second anionic/reset route is identified beyond SLES; however the SLES/salt chassis is too cleansing-led for low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: early cationic guar, panthenol, apricot oil, coconut extract and later amodimethicone/dimethicone create multiple complementary rinse-off care routes.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The product remains a rinse-off SLES shampoo, but the breadth and position of care routes make moderate too low.

weightPotential.rationale: High: early cationic guar, plant oil, dual silicones and later waxy/refatting materials create converging persistent deposition potential despite SLES/CAPB reset.
weightPotential.counterSignal: The formula has a real SLES/CAPB cleanser chassis and PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil is not counted as persistent payload under v1.4.

unresolvedFacts: Exact silicone/polymer/oil levels cannot be proven from INCI order alone.
PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Laureth-4, Laureth-23 and Trideceth-10 are preserved as helper/emulsion facts rather than independent persistent payload routes.
weightAssessment.whyThisBand: The formula combines early cationic polymer with dual silicones and plant/waxy care materials, so the residue picture is broader than one bounded route.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate because the persistent silicone plus cationic-polymer architecture is too convergent to treat as only ordinary rinse-off softness.

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: exact-product positioning targets damaged/dry hair and repair, and the formula supports that with polymer, panthenol, oil and silicone care routes.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Dry-hair language is also present, but moisture is not a v1.4 focus and the repair/damaged-hair claim dominates.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the dry-hair and smoothing claims support the same repair/care story rather than a distinct v1.4 secondary focus.

formulaFacts.observation: moisture-adjacent clue not available as v1.4 focus
smoothing route serving the repair focus

focusSecondary.counterSignal: Silicones can support shine/smoothness, but the source packet does not provide a distinct shine-led product positioning.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are ordinary wet-hair distribution, short contact and rinse-out, with no daily, alternating, reset or treatment trigger.
usageRole.counterSignal: Repair positioning changes focus, not product-level usage cadence.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product targets damaged/dry hair fiber repair, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Dry-hair positioning is present, but v1.4 requires scalp-comfort intent/support, not hair dryness alone.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

formulaFacts.observation: preservative-related salicylate, not a v1.4 dandruff active

dandruffSupport.counterSignal: No recognized v1.4 anti-dandruff active appears in the complete ordered INCI.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Both lanes selected moderate; SLES is buffered by CAPB and a care-rich polymer/oil/silicone phase, with no extra reset route beyond the sulfate chassis.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Both lanes selected high; early cationic guar plus panthenol, oil/extract and dual silicones create more than ordinary rinse-off manageability.

weightPotential.rationale: Adjudicated to high. Lane A correctly preserved the SLES/CAPB reset counter-signal, but the formula combines early cationic polymer, plant oil, amodimethicone, dimethicone and waxy lipid clues; under v1.4, reset does not automatically cancel converging persistent deposition.

focusPrimary.rationale: Both lanes selected repair after unblind; damaged/dry-hair repair positioning is formula-compatible with polymer, oil, panthenol and silicone care routes.

focusSecondary.rationale: Both lanes selected no secondary focus; smoothing/dry-hair language supports the same repair role rather than a distinct v1.4 focus.

usageRole.rationale: Both lanes selected regular; directions are ordinary rinse-out shampoo use with no reset, treatment, frequent-use or alternating trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Both lanes selected not_targeted; the product targets damaged/dry hair fiber, not sensitive or uncomfortable scalp.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Both lanes agree with the mechanical dandruff rule: no Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole in the complete INCI.

systematicRuleGap: Schauma exposes a weight calibration edge: moderate reset can coexist with high persistent deposition when polymer, oil and dual silicones converge.
methodNote: Final values were adjudicated against the frozen v1.4 standard without changing sources, rules, or labels to improve agreement. Claims were used only for claim-gated focus/usage/scalp intent, never to assign cleansing, conditioning or weight by themselves.
